title: Quarterly User Access Review
objective: Verify every active account on in-scope systems maps to a current employee or contractor with a least-privilege role, and remove dormant or orphaned accounts.

prerequisites.label: Read access to AD and core banking user tables
prerequisites.detail: Read-only directory and core banking user/role query rights for the review window.

prerequisites.label: Current HR headcount export
prerequisites.detail: HRIS export of active staff and contractors as of the review date.

prerequisites.label: Approval ticket for the review window
prerequisites.detail: Change/service ticket authorising the access review and any account disables.

prerequisites.label: Privileged access register
prerequisites.detail: Current register of approved privileged accounts with approval references.

sections.title: Data collection
sections.description: Gather authoritative identity data from HR and every in-scope system.

steps.title: Export HR active staff list
steps.instructionMd: Export the HR active staff and contractor list as of the review date. Save it as CSV with employee ID, name, department and line manager.
steps.commandBlock: # HRIS → Reports → Active headcount as at <review_date> → Export CSV
steps.expectedResult: CSV containing every active employee and contractor with line manager.

steps.title: Export AD accounts
steps.instructionMd: Export all Active Directory user accounts with last logon date, enabled flag and group membership.
steps.commandBlock:
Get-ADUser -Filter * -Properties LastLogonDate,Enabled,MemberOf |
  Select-Object SamAccountName,Name,Enabled,LastLogonDate,@{n='Groups';e={($_.MemberOf -join ';')}} |
  Export-Csv -NoTypeInformation ad_users.csv
# LDAP alternative:
# ldapsearch -H ldaps://<dc-host> -D "<bind_dn>" -W -b "<base_dn>" "(objectClass=person)" sAMAccountName userAccountControl lastLogonTimestamp memberOf
steps.expectedResult: ad_users.csv lists every AD user with LastLogonDate, Enabled and MemberOf.

steps.title: Export core banking users and roles
steps.instructionMd: Export all core banking users with role, last login and status. Adapt the query to your core banking schema.
steps.commandBlock:
-- Finacle (adapt table/columns to your release)
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NAME, ROLE, LAST_LOGIN, STATUS
  FROM UPR
 WHERE BANK_ID = '01';
-- T24 / BankOne: export the USER application listing via the vendor report
steps.expectedResult: Result set of every core banking user with role, last login and status.

evidenceReqs.label: Core banking user and role export

steps.title: Export database privileged roles
steps.instructionMd: Export database roles that hold superuser or role-creation privileges on each in-scope database.
steps.expectedResult: List of database roles with superuser / create-role flags.

sections.title: Analysis and attestation
sections.description: Reconcile system accounts against HR and flag exceptions for action.

steps.title: Reconcile system users against HR
steps.instructionMd: Reconcile every system account against the HR list and flag accounts with no matching active employee as orphaned.
steps.commandBlock: # Atheris reconciliation helper or spreadsheet VLOOKUP on employee ID / UPN
steps.expectedResult: Every account is either matched to an HR record or flagged as orphaned.

steps.title: Flag dormant accounts
steps.instructionMd: Flag enabled accounts with no login in the last 90 days as dormant.
steps.commandBlock:
$cutoff = (Get-Date).AddDays(-90)
Import-Csv ad_users.csv |
  Where-Object { $_.Enabled -eq 'True' -and ([datetime]$_.LastLogonDate -lt $cutoff) } |
  Export-Csv -NoTypeInformation dormant_90d.csv
steps.expectedResult: List of enabled accounts whose last logon is older than 90 days.

steps.title: Confirm privileged account approvals
steps.instructionMd: Flag every privileged account and confirm an approval exists for it in the privileged access register.
steps.expectedResult: Each privileged account has an approval reference or is flagged as an exception.

steps.title: Request manager attestations
steps.instructionMd: Send a role-appropriateness attestation request to each line manager for their team's accounts.
steps.commandBlock: # Atheris → Notifications → Send attestation request to line managers
steps.expectedResult: All line managers have attested or been chased before the deadline.

sections.title: Remediation
sections.description: Remove access that is not justified, under dual control.

steps.title: Disable dormant and orphaned accounts
steps.instructionMd: Disable each dormant or orphaned account listed in the approved exception list. A second operator must verify each disable against the ticket.
steps.commandBlock:
# Active Directory
Disable-ADAccount -Identity <sam>
# Finacle: disable the user via the user maintenance menu per SOP (adapt)
steps.expectedResult: Every approved account shows Enabled = False in AD and is locked in core banking.
steps.safetyNote: Disabling accounts blocks user access immediately. Disable only accounts on the approved list and never service accounts without the owning team's confirmation.

steps.title: Verify disabled accounts cannot authenticate
steps.instructionMd: Verify each disabled account cannot authenticate by checking its status and attempting a test login.
steps.commandBlock: Get-ADUser <sam> -Properties Enabled | Select-Object SamAccountName, Enabled
steps.expectedResult: Enabled = False and the test login is refused.

sections.title: Close-out
sections.description: Summarise the review and obtain sign-off.

steps.title: Compile review summary
steps.instructionMd: Compile the review summary with account counts, exceptions and actions taken.
steps.commandBlock: # Auto-generated by Atheris from step results
steps.expectedResult: Summary covers counts, exceptions, actions and outstanding items.

steps.title: CCO sign-off
steps.instructionMd: Confirm the review is complete and sign off in Atheris.
steps.expectedResult: CCO sign-off recorded against the execution.

escalations.instructions: Investigate the failed step and decide to retry, pause or roll back.
Review progress; the quarterly access review is at 80% of its SLA.
Escalate the overdue access review to the CISO and tenant administrator.

rollback.title: Re-enable wrongly disabled account
rollback.instructionMd: Re-enable the account, document the reason in the ticket and re-verify that the user can log in.
rollback.verification: Get-ADUser <sam> -Properties Enabled shows Enabled = True and the user confirms login.

title: Monthly Vulnerability Scan, Patch and Report
objective: Scan all in-scope assets for vulnerabilities, remediate CVSS 7.0+ findings within policy timelines, verify by rescan and report to the CISO and CCO.

prerequisites.label: Vulnerability scanner
prerequisites.detail: Nessus, Qualys or OpenVAS/Greenbone with current plugin feed.

prerequisites.label: Scan service account
prerequisites.detail: Authenticated scan credentials stored in the scanner vault; never typed into commands.

prerequisites.label: Current asset register
prerequisites.detail: CMDB / asset register export for scope confirmation.

prerequisites.label: Approved patch window
prerequisites.detail: Production change window approved by the CAB.

sections.title: Scope and readiness
sections.description: Confirm what will be scanned and that the scanner is ready.

steps.title: Confirm scan scope
steps.instructionMd: Confirm the scan target list matches the current asset register and record any gaps.
steps.expectedResult: Every in-scope asset is a scan target; gaps are recorded.

steps.title: Update scanner feeds
steps.instructionMd: Update the scanner plugin or feed set and confirm the update succeeded.
steps.commandBlock:
# Nessus
nessuscli update --plugins-only
# Greenbone / OpenVAS
gvm-cli --gmp-username "${GVM_USER}" --gmp-password "${GVM_PASSWORD}" socket --xml "<get_feeds/>"
steps.expectedResult: Scanner reports a plugin/feed date within the last 7 days.

sections.title: Scan, triage and remediate
sections.description: Run the scan, prioritise findings and patch.

steps.title: Run authenticated scan
steps.instructionMd: Run the authenticated internal scan against the confirmed scope and wait for it to complete.
steps.commandBlock:
# Nessus REST (keys from env, never inline)
curl -s -X POST -H "X-ApiKeys: accessKey=${NESSUS_ACCESS_KEY}; secretKey=${NESSUS_SECRET_KEY}" https://<nessus-host>:8834/scans/<scan_id>/launch
# Greenbone / OpenVAS
gvm-cli --gmp-username "${GVM_USER}" --gmp-password "${GVM_PASSWORD}" socket --xml '<start_task task_id="<task_id>"/>'
steps.expectedResult: Scan completes with authentication succeeding on all targets.

steps.title: Export scan results
steps.instructionMd: Export the full scan report and a CSV of findings for triage.
steps.commandBlock: gvm-cli --gmp-username "${GVM_USER}" --gmp-password "${GVM_PASSWORD}" socket --xml '<get_reports report_id="<report_id>" format_id="<csv_format_id>"/>' > scan_<yyyymm>.xml
steps.expectedResult: Report and CSV contain all findings with CVSS scores.

steps.title: Triage findings by severity
steps.instructionMd: Triage every finding with CVSS 7.0 or higher and assign an owner and due date. Critical findings are due within 30 days.
steps.expectedResult: Each high/critical finding has an owner, due date and decision.

evidenceReqs.label: Triage register with owners and due dates

steps.title: Raise change tickets
steps.instructionMd: Raise a change ticket for each remediation batch and link it to the findings.
steps.expectedResult: All remediation batches have approved change tickets.

steps.title: Back up before patching
steps.instructionMd: Take a snapshot or backup of each production system before patching and record its reference.
steps.commandBlock:
# VMware
# New-Snapshot -VM <vm_name> -Name pre-patch-<yyyymmdd>
# Linux LVM
lvcreate -s -n prepatch_<yyyymmdd> -L 10G /dev/<vg>/<lv>
steps.expectedResult: Restorable snapshot exists for every system in the patch batch.

steps.title: Patch the test environment
steps.instructionMd: Apply the patches in the test environment and run smoke tests before production.
steps.commandBlock:
# RHEL / Oracle Linux
sudo yum -y update --security
# Windows
# Install-WindowsUpdate -KBArticleID <kb_id> -AcceptAll (PSWindowsUpdate module)
steps.expectedResult: Patches install cleanly and smoke tests pass in test.

evidenceReqs.label: Test patch log and smoke-test result

steps.title: Patch production in the window
steps.instructionMd: Apply the tested patches to production inside the approved change window.
steps.commandBlock:
# RHEL / Oracle Linux
sudo yum -y update --security
sudo yum history list | head -5
# Windows: deploy approved KBs via WSUS / SCCM
steps.expectedResult: Patches installed on all production targets within the window.
steps.safetyNote: Production patching may restart services. Patch only inside the approved window with the snapshot from step 2.5 available.

steps.title: Record deferred patch exceptions
steps.instructionMd: Record each deferred patch with compensating controls and obtain risk acceptance from the CISO.
steps.expectedResult: Every deferred high/critical finding has a signed exception.

sections.title: Verification
sections.description: Prove remediation worked and services are healthy.

steps.title: Rescan remediated assets
steps.instructionMd: Rescan the remediated assets and compare the results with the original scan.
steps.commandBlock: gvm-cli --gmp-username "${GVM_USER}" --gmp-password "${GVM_PASSWORD}" socket --xml '<start_task task_id="<rescan_task_id>"/>'
steps.expectedResult: Remediated findings no longer appear; remaining ones are under exception.

steps.title: Verify service health
steps.instructionMd: Verify that patched services are running and responding normally.
steps.commandBlock:
systemctl --failed
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://<service-host>/health
steps.expectedResult: All patched services report healthy.

steps.title: Compile vulnerability report
steps.instructionMd: Compile the monthly report with scan coverage, open findings by severity, SLA status and exceptions.
steps.expectedResult: Report delivered to CISO and CCO.

steps.title: CISO and CCO sign-off
steps.instructionMd: Confirm the report is accurate and sign off.
steps.expectedResult: Sign-off recorded.

escalations.instructions: Investigate the failed scan or patch step.
Critical vulnerabilities are approaching the remediation SLA; confirm the patch plan.
Critical CVE unpatched beyond SLA; escalate to the MD and board risk committee.

rollback.title: Revert the production patch
rollback.instructionMd: Revert the patch transaction or uninstall the KB, or restore the pre-patch snapshot, then verify service health.
rollback.commandBlock:
# RHEL / Oracle Linux
sudo yum history undo <transaction_id>
# Windows
# wusa /uninstall /kb:<kb_id> /quiet /norestart
# VMware: revert to snapshot pre-patch-<yyyymmdd>
rollback.verification: Service health checks pass and the system runs the pre-patch version.

title: Data Breach Response and Regulatory Notification (NDPA / CBN)
objective: Contain a suspected personal data or cyber breach, assess its impact, notify the CBN within 24 hours and the NDPC within 72 hours, and recover safely.

prerequisites.label: Incident response access
prerequisites.detail: Emergency access to firewalls, EDR, directory and SIEM for responders.

prerequisites.label: Forensic storage
prerequisites.detail: Write-once forensic share with enough capacity for log and image capture.

prerequisites.label: Regulator contact details and templates
prerequisites.detail: CBN incident report template, NDPC breach notification form, ngCERT contact.

prerequisites.label: Incident commander designated
prerequisites.detail: Named incident commander and deputy on the on-call roster.

sections.title: Pre-check (T+0–1h)
sections.description: Stand up the response and preserve evidence before anything changes.

steps.title: Confirm incident commander and open ticket
steps.instructionMd: Confirm the incident commander and open an incident ticket with detection time, reporter and initial scope.
steps.expectedResult: Incident ticket open with T0 (detection time) recorded.

steps.title: Preserve logs and start evidence log
steps.instructionMd: Copy relevant logs to forensic storage and hash them before any containment change. Start the evidence and decision timeline.
steps.commandBlock:
mkdir -p /forensics/<incident_id>
cp -a /var/log /forensics/<incident_id>/
find /forensics/<incident_id> -type f -exec sha256sum {} + > /forensics/<incident_id>/manifest.sha256
steps.expectedResult: Logs copied with a SHA-256 manifest; timeline started.

steps.title: Notify the CISO
steps.instructionMd: Notify the CISO with the initial facts and confirm the response team is engaged.
steps.expectedResult: CISO acknowledged within 15 minutes.

sections.title: Containment (T+1–8h)
sections.description: Stop the spread and cut attacker access.

steps.title: Isolate affected hosts
steps.instructionMd: Isolate affected hosts by quarantining them on the NAC/EDR or blocking them at the firewall.
steps.commandBlock:
# Linux host firewall
iptables -I INPUT -s <affected_ip> -j DROP
iptables -I OUTPUT -d <affected_ip> -j DROP
# FortiGate: add <affected_ip> to the quarantine address group
# config firewall addrgrp → edit "QUARANTINE" → append member <affected_host_obj>
steps.expectedResult: Affected hosts have no network path except the forensic VLAN.
steps.safetyNote: Isolation interrupts service on the affected host. Confirm the host list with the incident commander and keep forensic access open.

steps.title: Revoke compromised credentials
steps.instructionMd: Disable compromised accounts and revoke their active sessions.
steps.commandBlock:
# Active Directory
Disable-ADAccount -Identity <sam>
# Entra ID / Microsoft 365
Revoke-MgUserSignInSession -UserId <upn>
steps.expectedResult: Compromised accounts are disabled and all sessions revoked.
steps.safetyNote: Disabling accounts may lock out legitimate users. Confirm each account against the compromise evidence before disabling.

steps.title: Rotate keys and tokens
steps.instructionMd: Rotate API keys, service credentials and tokens exposed in the incident and update dependent services.
steps.commandBlock:
# AWS KMS (on-demand rotation)
aws kms rotate-key-on-demand --key-id <key_id>
# Rotate application secrets in the vault; never paste secret values here
steps.expectedResult: All exposed secrets are rotated and dependent services work.

steps.title: Block indicators of compromise
steps.instructionMd: Block known IOCs (IPs, domains, hashes) on the firewall, proxy and EDR.
steps.commandBlock:
# FortiGate
config firewall address
  edit "IOC-<incident_id>-1"
    set subnet <ioc_ip> 255.255.255.255
  next
end
steps.expectedResult: All known IOCs are blocked on every control point.

sections.title: Assessment (T+8–24h)
sections.description: Determine what data and people are affected.

steps.title: Determine affected data and subject count
steps.instructionMd: Determine the personal data categories exposed and the approximate number of data subjects affected.
steps.commandBlock:
-- PostgreSQL (adapt to affected tables)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS subjects
  FROM <affected_table>
 WHERE accessed_at BETWEEN '<t_start>' AND '<t_end>';
steps.expectedResult: Data categories and subject count documented with method.

steps.title: Classify incident severity
steps.instructionMd: Classify the incident severity using the incident classification matrix and record the rationale.
steps.expectedResult: Severity recorded and agreed by the incident commander.

steps.title: Assess likelihood of harm
steps.instructionMd: Decide whether the breach is likely to result in harm to data subjects and record the reasoning for NDPA purposes.
steps.expectedResult: Documented decision on the NDPA notification trigger.

sections.title: Regulatory notification — CBN (≤24h)
sections.description: Initial cyber incident report to the CBN within 24 hours of detection.

steps.title: Complete the CBN initial incident report
steps.instructionMd: Complete the Atheris CBN initial incident report template with the facts known so far.
steps.expectedResult: Report draft complete.

steps.title: Obtain CISO approval
steps.instructionMd: Obtain CISO approval of the CBN initial report.
steps.expectedResult: Report approved.

steps.title: Submit to CBN and capture acknowledgement
steps.instructionMd: Submit the report through the prescribed CBN channel and save the acknowledgement.
steps.expectedResult: Submitted within 24 hours of detection with acknowledgement saved.

sections.title: Regulatory notification — NDPC (≤72h)
sections.description: Breach notification to the NDPC within 72 hours of awareness.

steps.title: Complete the NDPC breach notification
steps.instructionMd: Complete the NDPC breach notification form with nature, data categories, approximate numbers, DPO contact, likely consequences and measures taken.
steps.expectedResult: Notification draft complete.

steps.title: Obtain DPO and CCO approval
steps.instructionMd: Obtain DPO and CCO approval of the NDPC notification.
steps.expectedResult: Both approvals recorded.

steps.title: Submit to NDPC and capture acknowledgement
steps.instructionMd: Submit the notification to the NDPC and save the acknowledgement.
steps.expectedResult: Submitted within 72 hours of awareness with acknowledgement saved.

steps.title: Report to ngCERT
steps.instructionMd: Report the incident to the national or sectoral CERT and record the reference.
steps.expectedResult: CERT report submitted with reference recorded.

sections.title: Data subject notification (if high risk)
sections.description: Inform affected individuals where the risk to them is high.

steps.title: Draft the data subject notice
steps.instructionMd: Draft a plain-language notice describing the breach, likely consequences, measures taken and contact point.
steps.expectedResult: Notice drafted.

steps.title: Complete legal review
steps.instructionMd: Obtain legal review and approval of the notice.
steps.expectedResult: Notice approved by legal.

steps.title: Dispatch and log notices
steps.instructionMd: Dispatch the notice to affected data subjects and log the dispatch counts.
steps.expectedResult: Notices sent without undue delay and logged.

sections.title: Eradication and recovery
sections.description: Remove the root cause and restore safely.

steps.title: Patch the root cause
steps.instructionMd: Patch or reconfigure the root cause and confirm the attack path is closed.
steps.expectedResult: Root cause remediated and verified.

steps.title: Restore from clean backup
steps.instructionMd: Restore affected systems from a verified clean backup taken before the compromise.
steps.commandBlock:
# PostgreSQL
pg_restore -h <host> -U "${DB_USER}" -d <target_db> /backups/<clean_backup>.dump
steps.expectedResult: Systems restored from a pre-compromise backup.

steps.title: Monitor for recurrence
steps.instructionMd: Monitor affected systems for indicators of recurrence for 14 days.
steps.expectedResult: No recurrence observed for 14 days.

sections.title: Close-out
sections.description: Learn from the incident and close it.

steps.title: Hold the post-incident review
steps.instructionMd: Hold the post-incident review within 10 business days and record root cause and lessons learned.
steps.expectedResult: Review held and report issued.

steps.title: Update controls and raise findings
steps.instructionMd: Raise findings for control gaps and update affected runbooks and controls.
steps.expectedResult: Findings raised and owners assigned.

steps.title: Record the loss event
steps.instructionMd: Record the incident as an operational loss event for the op-risk register.
steps.expectedResult: Loss event recorded.

steps.title: CCO sign-off
steps.instructionMd: Confirm all notifications, actions and evidence are complete and sign off.
steps.expectedResult: Incident closed with sign-off.

escalations.instructions: SOC lead: investigate the failed step immediately.
Escalate to the CISO if the failure is unresolved after 15 minutes.
Regulatory deadline at risk; the CCO must confirm the notification plan.
NDPC 72-hour deadline at risk; the DPO must finalise the notification.
Inform the MD/CEO and Board Risk Chair; also escalate when 1,000 or more data subjects are affected.

rollback.title: Remove containment rules
rollback.instructionMd: Remove the isolation rules after the incident commander validates the host is clean, then restore service.
rollback.commandBlock:
iptables -D INPUT -s <affected_ip> -j DROP
iptables -D OUTPUT -d <affected_ip> -j DROP
# FortiGate: unselect <affected_host_obj> from the QUARANTINE group
rollback.verification: Host is reachable, services respond and monitoring shows no malicious activity.

rollback.title: Re-enable cleared accounts
rollback.instructionMd: Re-enable accounts confirmed not compromised after a credential reset, and document the decision.
rollback.verification: User logs in successfully with new credentials and MFA.

title: Server, Firewall and Database Configuration Baseline Audit
objective: Compare server, firewall and database configurations against the approved hardening baseline, remediate or approve deviations, and prove compliance by rescan.

prerequisites.label: Approved hardening baseline
prerequisites.detail: CIS Benchmark version or internal hardening standard approved by the CISO.

prerequisites.label: Configuration checkers
prerequisites.detail: OpenSCAP or Lynis on Linux, CIS-CAT or secedit on Windows, CLI access to firewalls.

prerequisites.label: Read-only admin access
prerequisites.detail: Read-only privileged access to in-scope hosts, devices and databases.

sections.title: Baseline and scope
sections.description: Confirm the yardstick and the assets.

steps.title: Pull the approved baseline
steps.instructionMd: Pull the current approved baseline and record its version.
steps.expectedResult: Baseline version recorded.

steps.title: Confirm in-scope assets
steps.instructionMd: Confirm the list of servers, devices and databases in scope for this quarter.
steps.expectedResult: Asset list agreed.

sections.title: Collect and compare
sections.description: Collect configurations and compare against the baseline.

steps.title: Run Linux baseline checks
steps.instructionMd: Run the CIS profile scan and Lynis audit on each in-scope Linux server.
steps.commandBlock:
oscap xccdf eval --profile xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_cis \
  --results /tmp/<host>-oscap.xml --report /tmp/<host>-oscap.html \
  /usr/share/xml/scap/ssg/content/ssg-<distro>-ds.xml
sudo lynis audit system --quiet --report-file /tmp/<host>-lynis.dat
steps.expectedResult: Results file and Lynis report produced for each host.

steps.title: Run Windows baseline checks
steps.instructionMd: Export the local security policy and audit policy from each in-scope Windows server.
steps.commandBlock:
secedit /export /cfg C:\audit\<host>-secpol.cfg
auditpol /get /category:* > C:\audit\<host>-auditpol.txt
# Or run CIS-CAT Pro Assessor against the CIS Windows Server benchmark
steps.expectedResult: Policy exports produced for each server.

steps.title: Export firewall configurations
steps.instructionMd: Export the full running configuration from each in-scope firewall.
steps.commandBlock:
# FortiGate
show full-configuration
# Cisco ASA / IOS
# show running-config
# Palo Alto
# show config running
steps.expectedResult: Full configuration exported for each device.

steps.title: Export database settings
steps.instructionMd: Export security-relevant database settings from each in-scope database.
steps.expectedResult: Settings export produced per database.

steps.title: Hash the exports
steps.instructionMd: Hash every configuration export so the evidence is tamper-evident.
steps.commandBlock: sha256sum /tmp/*-oscap.xml /tmp/*-lynis.dat /audit/*.cfg /audit/*.txt > config_manifest.sha256
steps.expectedResult: Manifest lists a SHA-256 for every export.

steps.title: Classify deviations
steps.instructionMd: Diff each export against the baseline and classify every deviation as remediate or exception.
steps.expectedResult: Each deviation has a classification and owner.

steps.title: Remediate deviations via change
steps.instructionMd: Remediate approved deviations through change control and record exceptions with risk acceptance.
steps.commandBlock:
# Apply hardening via configuration management (dry run first)
ansible-playbook -i inventory hardening.yml --limit <host> --check --diff
ansible-playbook -i inventory hardening.yml --limit <host>
steps.expectedResult: Deviations remediated or covered by signed exceptions.
steps.safetyNote: Hardening changes can break services. Run the dry run first and apply only within an approved change window.

steps.title: Rescan remediated assets
steps.instructionMd: Rescan the remediated assets with the same profile and compare with the first run.
steps.commandBlock: oscap xccdf eval --profile xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_cis --results /tmp/<host>-oscap-rescan.xml /usr/share/xml/scap/ssg/content/ssg-<distro>-ds.xml
steps.expectedResult: Remediated deviations now pass.

steps.title: Verify connectivity and services
steps.instructionMd: Verify that remediated hosts and devices keep connectivity and that services respond.
steps.commandBlock:
systemctl --failed
nc -zv <dependent_host> <port>
steps.expectedResult: All services healthy.

steps.title: Compile the baseline audit report
steps.instructionMd: Compile the audit report with compliance percentage per asset, deviations, exceptions and changes.
steps.expectedResult: Report complete.

steps.title: CCO sign-off
steps.instructionMd: Confirm the audit is complete and sign off.
steps.expectedResult: Sign-off recorded.

escalations.instructions: Investigate the failed collection or remediation step.
Configuration audit at 80% of SLA; confirm the remediation plan.
Configuration audit overdue; record a finding.

rollback.title: Restore last known-good configuration
rollback.instructionMd: Restore the last known-good configuration from backup or version control, then verify connectivity and services.
rollback.commandBlock:
# FortiGate
execute restore config tftp <config_file> <tftp_server_ip>
# Infrastructure as code
git checkout <last_good_tag> -- <path>
ansible-playbook -i inventory baseline.yml --limit <host>
rollback.verification: Connectivity and services restored; configuration matches the known-good version.

title: Encryption Key and Certificate Rotation
objective: Rotate encryption keys and certificates before expiry under dual control, without service interruption, and keep the key register current.

prerequisites.label: Two key custodians
prerequisites.detail: Two authorised key custodians available for dual control.

prerequisites.label: HSM / KMS access
prerequisites.detail: Access to the HSM or cloud KMS and the certificate authority.

prerequisites.label: Cutover window
prerequisites.detail: Approved window for certificate binding and key cutover.

sections.title: Inventory and backup
sections.description: Know what rotates and keep a way back.

steps.title: Inventory keys and certificates
steps.instructionMd: Inventory the keys and certificates due for rotation with their expiry dates.
steps.commandBlock:
openssl x509 -in <cert.pem> -noout -subject -enddate
aws kms list-keys --output table
steps.expectedResult: Inventory lists every item due with expiry date.

steps.title: Back up current keys to escrow
steps.instructionMd: Back up the current key material to the HSM or escrow under dual control.
steps.expectedResult: Backup confirmed by both custodians.

sections.title: Rotate
sections.description: Generate new material and cut over.

steps.title: Generate the new key
steps.instructionMd: Generate the new key or key version under dual control.
steps.commandBlock:
# AWS KMS
aws kms rotate-key-on-demand --key-id <key_id>
# OpenSSL (TLS key + CSR)
openssl req -new -newkey rsa:3072 -nodes -keyout <host>.key -out <host>.csr -subj "/CN=<host>"
steps.expectedResult: New key version active in the HSM/KMS.

steps.title: Re-issue and bind the certificate
steps.instructionMd: Install the re-issued certificate and switch the binding to the new key under dual control.
steps.expectedResult: Endpoint presents the new certificate.
steps.safetyNote: A wrong binding causes an outage. Keep the previous certificate available for immediate rollback.

sections.title: Verify
sections.description: Prove the new material is in use.

steps.title: Verify the new certificate
steps.instructionMd: Verify the endpoint serves the new certificate with the correct chain and expiry.
steps.commandBlock: openssl s_client -connect <host>:443 -servername <host> </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -serial -enddate
steps.expectedResult: New serial and expiry shown; chain verifies.

sections.title: Retire and record
sections.description: Retire old material and update the register.

steps.title: Retire the old key
steps.instructionMd: Retire the previous key version after the grace period under dual control.
steps.commandBlock: aws kms disable-key --key-id <old_key_id>
steps.expectedResult: Old key disabled and no service uses it.
steps.safetyNote: Retiring a key still in use makes data unreadable. Confirm no decrypt calls used the old key during the grace period.

steps.title: Update the key register
steps.instructionMd: Update the key and certificate register with new versions, custodians and next rotation dates.
steps.expectedResult: Register reflects the rotation.

escalations.instructions: Rotation step failed; decide whether to roll back.
Key/certificate rotation at 80% of SLA; expiry risk.

rollback.title: Revert certificate binding
rollback.instructionMd: Rebind the previous certificate and re-activate the previous key version, then verify the endpoint.
rollback.commandBlock: # Re-point the listener to the previous certificate; KMS: re-enable the previous key version if disabled
rollback.verification: Endpoint serves the previous certificate and clients connect.

rollback.title: Re-enable the old key
rollback.instructionMd: Re-enable the retired key if any data or service still depends on it.
rollback.verification: Decrypt operations using the old key succeed.

title: Backup Integrity and DR Restore Test
objective: Prove that backups are complete and restorable within the approved RTO and RPO by restoring samples into an isolated environment.

prerequisites.label: Isolated restore environment
prerequisites.detail: Network-isolated environment for restore tests.

prerequisites.label: Approved RTO/RPO targets
prerequisites.detail: Business impact analysis targets for each in-scope system.

steps.title: Select sample backups
steps.instructionMd: Select sample backups covering each critical system and record their dates.
steps.expectedResult: Samples cover every critical system.

steps.title: Verify backup checksums
steps.instructionMd: Verify the checksum of each sample backup against the backup catalogue.
steps.commandBlock: sha256sum -c /backups/<set>/SHA256SUMS
steps.expectedResult: All checksums match.

sections.title: Restore and test
sections.description: Restore into isolation and test integrity.

steps.title: Restore to the isolated environment
steps.instructionMd: Restore each sample into the isolated environment and record start and end times.
steps.commandBlock:
# PostgreSQL
createdb -h <dr_host> -U "${DB_USER}" restore_test_<yyyymmdd>
pg_restore -h <dr_host> -U "${DB_USER}" -d restore_test_<yyyymmdd> /backups/<set>/<db>.dump
# Finacle: follow the vendor DR restore procedure
steps.expectedResult: Restore completes; timings recorded.

steps.title: Run integrity queries
steps.instructionMd: Run integrity queries comparing row counts and control totals with production at backup time.
steps.commandBlock: SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts, SUM(balance) AS total_balance FROM <accounts_table>;
steps.expectedResult: Counts and totals match the source at backup time.

steps.title: Measure RTO and RPO achieved
steps.instructionMd: Measure the RTO and RPO achieved and compare them with the approved targets.
steps.expectedResult: Achieved values recorded; breaches flagged.

steps.title: Report the test results
steps.instructionMd: Compile the restore test report with results, gaps and actions, and obtain CCO sign-off.
steps.expectedResult: Report signed off.

escalations.instructions: Restore or integrity check failed; investigate the backup chain.
Restore test at 80% of SLA.
Restore test overdue; raise a finding.

title: Privileged Activity and Security Log Review
objective: Review privileged sessions, failed logins, after-hours access, database admin actions and maker-checker overrides each week and act on exceptions.

prerequisites.label: SIEM read access
prerequisites.detail: Read access to the SIEM and database audit logs.

steps.title: Confirm log sources are reporting
steps.instructionMd: Confirm every in-scope log source sent events in the review period.
steps.expectedResult: No silent log sources.

steps.title: Pull privileged session logs
steps.instructionMd: Pull privileged logon and privileged session events for the week.
steps.commandBlock:
# SIEM search (Splunk SPL; adapt for your SIEM)
index=wineventlog EventCode=4672 earliest=-7d | stats count by user, host
steps.expectedResult: Result set of privileged logons for the period.

steps.title: Pull failed and after-hours logins
steps.instructionMd: Pull failed logins and successful logins outside business hours.
steps.commandBlock:
index=wineventlog (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4624) earliest=-7d
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H") | where EventCode=4625 OR hour<7 OR hour>19
| stats count by user, EventCode
steps.expectedResult: Result set of failed and after-hours logins.

steps.title: Pull database admin actions
steps.instructionMd: Pull database administrative actions recorded by pgaudit or the equivalent audit trail.
steps.commandBlock:
# PostgreSQL pgaudit
grep -h 'AUDIT: SESSION' /var/log/postgresql/postgresql-*.log | grep -E 'ROLE|DDL'
-- Oracle: SELECT * FROM unified_audit_trail WHERE event_timestamp > SYSDATE - 7
steps.expectedResult: Extract of DDL and role changes for the week.

steps.title: Pull maker-checker overrides
steps.instructionMd: Pull core banking maker-checker overrides and self-authorisations for the week. Adapt the query to your schema.
steps.commandBlock:
-- Finacle (adapt)
SELECT TRAN_ID, ENTRY_USER_ID, VFD_USER_ID, TRAN_DATE
  FROM <tran_table>
 WHERE ENTRY_USER_ID = VFD_USER_ID AND TRAN_DATE >= SYSDATE - 7;
steps.expectedResult: List of overrides with maker and checker IDs.

steps.title: Review events and raise exceptions
steps.instructionMd: Review each dataset for unexplained activity and raise an exception or finding for each one.
steps.expectedResult: Every anomaly is explained or raised.

steps.title: Attest the weekly review
steps.instructionMd: Attest that the weekly review is complete.
steps.expectedResult: Attestation recorded.

escalations.instructions: Log review step failed or log source silent.
Weekly log review at 80% of SLA.

title: Regulatory Return Preparation and Submission
objective: Prepare, validate, approve and submit a CBN regulatory return on time with maker-checker control, and file the acknowledgement.

prerequisites.label: CBN portal access
prerequisites.detail: Submitter access to the CBN returns portal.

prerequisites.label: Prior-period return
prerequisites.detail: Last submitted return for variance analysis.

steps.title: Pull the data extract
steps.instructionMd: Pull the return data extract for the reporting period from the source system.
steps.commandBlock:
-- Adapt to the return's source tables
SELECT * FROM <return_source_view> WHERE period_end = '<period_end>';
steps.expectedResult: Extract covers the full period.

steps.title: Validate against prior period
steps.instructionMd: Validate the extract against the prior period and explain every variance above the threshold.
steps.expectedResult: All variances above threshold explained.

steps.title: Prepare the return (maker)
steps.instructionMd: Prepare the return in the prescribed template.
steps.expectedResult: Return prepared.

steps.title: Review the return (checker)
steps.instructionMd: Review the prepared return against source data and the validation rules.
steps.expectedResult: Return reviewed with no open errors.

steps.title: Submit on the CBN portal
steps.instructionMd: Submit the approved return on the CBN portal and save the acknowledgement.
steps.commandBlock: # CBN returns portal → Upload return → Submit → Download acknowledgement
steps.expectedResult: Submission accepted before the deadline.

steps.title: File the return in the Vault
steps.instructionMd: File the return, workings and acknowledgement in the Atheris Vault against the return period.
steps.expectedResult: Return pack filed.

escalations.instructions: Return preparation step failed; the filing deadline may be at risk.
Escalate to management if the return cannot be filed on time.

title: Data Subject Access Request (NDPA)
objective: Verify, fulfil and record a data subject access request within the statutory period.

prerequisites.label: Data inventory
prerequisites.detail: Current inventory of systems holding personal data.

steps.title: Verify the requester's identity
steps.instructionMd: Verify the requester's identity against records held before disclosing anything.
steps.expectedResult: Identity verified or request paused pending proof.

steps.title: Log the request
steps.instructionMd: Log the request with the received date and statutory due date.
steps.expectedResult: Request logged with due date.

steps.title: Locate personal data across systems
steps.instructionMd: Search every system in the data inventory for the data subject's personal data.
steps.commandBlock:
-- Adapt per system
SELECT * FROM <customer_table> WHERE customer_id = '<customer_id>';
steps.expectedResult: Every inventoried system searched.

steps.title: Compile the response pack
steps.instructionMd: Compile the data and the processing information into a response pack, redacting third-party data.
steps.expectedResult: Pack complete and redacted.

steps.title: Complete legal and DPO review
steps.instructionMd: Review the pack for completeness, exemptions and redactions.
steps.expectedResult: Pack approved.

steps.title: Send the response
steps.instructionMd: Send the response pack to the data subject through a secure channel.
steps.expectedResult: Response sent within the statutory period.

steps.title: Record closure
steps.instructionMd: Record the closure date and outcome in the DSAR register.
steps.expectedResult: Register updated.

escalations.instructions: DSAR step failed; check the statutory deadline.
DSAR at 80% of the statutory period.

title: Suspicious Transaction Report Filing
objective: Investigate a suspicious activity alert and, where suspicion is confirmed, file an STR with the NFIU on goAML within 24 hours.

prerequisites.label: goAML reporting access
prerequisites.detail: Active goAML reporting entity account for the MLRO.

steps.title: Triage the alert
steps.instructionMd: Triage the alert and record whether it warrants investigation. Do not alert the customer.
steps.expectedResult: Alert closed as false positive or opened for investigation.

steps.title: Investigate the activity
steps.instructionMd: Pull the customer's transactions and KYC profile and document the investigation.
steps.commandBlock:
SELECT tran_date, amount, counterparty, channel FROM <transactions>
 WHERE customer_id = '<customer_id>' AND tran_date >= '<from_date>';
steps.expectedResult: Investigation documented.

steps.title: Record the MLRO decision
steps.instructionMd: Record the MLRO decision to file or not file, with reasons.
steps.expectedResult: Decision recorded.

steps.title: Draft the STR on goAML
steps.instructionMd: Draft the STR on goAML with the grounds for suspicion and the transaction details.
steps.commandBlock: # goAML web → New report → STR
steps.expectedResult: STR draft complete.

steps.title: Submit the STR and capture the reference
steps.instructionMd: Submit the STR and save the goAML reference number.
steps.expectedResult: STR submitted within 24 hours with reference saved.

steps.title: Retain the case file
steps.instructionMd: Retain the case file, STR and reference for at least five years.
steps.expectedResult: Case file retained.

escalations.instructions: STR step failed; the 24-hour deadline is at risk.
STR at 80% of the 24-hour deadline.
STR deadline breached; inform the MD and record the breach.

title: Third-Party / Vendor Security Review
objective: Assess the security and data protection posture of each critical vendor annually and act on the risks found.

prerequisites.label: Vendor register
prerequisites.detail: Register of critical vendors with services and data shared.

steps.title: Confirm vendor criticality
steps.instructionMd: Confirm the vendor's criticality and the data and systems it can access.
steps.expectedResult: Criticality confirmed.

steps.title: Send the security questionnaire
steps.instructionMd: Send the security questionnaire and evidence request to the vendor.
steps.expectedResult: Vendor acknowledges the request.

steps.title: Review the vendor's evidence
steps.instructionMd: Review the questionnaire answers and evidence such as ISO 27001 certificates, SOC 2 reports and penetration test summaries.
steps.expectedResult: Evidence reviewed with gaps noted.

steps.title: Verify contract clauses
steps.instructionMd: Verify the contract includes security, breach notification, audit and NDPA processor obligations.
steps.expectedResult: Missing clauses identified.

steps.title: Rate the vendor and raise findings
steps.instructionMd: Rate the vendor's residual risk and raise findings for material gaps.
steps.expectedResult: Rating recorded; findings raised.

steps.title: Approve the review outcome
steps.instructionMd: Approve renewal, conditional renewal or exit, and sign off.
steps.expectedResult: Decision recorded.

escalations.instructions: Vendor review step failed or vendor unresponsive.
Vendor review at 80% of SLA.

title: Emergency Change Control
objective: Implement an emergency production change safely with a validated rollback plan, emergency approval and retrospective CAB review.

prerequisites.label: Emergency CAB quorum
prerequisites.detail: At least two ECAB approvers reachable.

prerequisites.label: Emergency window
prerequisites.detail: Agreed implementation window communicated to stakeholders.

sections.title: Justify and approve
sections.description: Justify the change and validate the way back.

steps.title: Log the emergency change
steps.instructionMd: Log the emergency change with justification, impact and affected services.
steps.expectedResult: Ticket logged.

steps.title: Validate the rollback plan
steps.instructionMd: Validate that the rollback plan is complete and has been tested or reviewed. Do not proceed without it.
steps.expectedResult: Rollback plan validated by a second engineer.

steps.title: Obtain ECAB approval
steps.instructionMd: Obtain emergency CAB approval and record the approvers.
steps.expectedResult: Approval recorded.

steps.title: Back up the current state
steps.instructionMd: Back up the current configuration or take a snapshot before changing anything.
steps.commandBlock:
git -C <config_repo> tag pre-ecab-<change_id>
# FortiGate
# execute backup config tftp <backup_file> <tftp_server_ip>
steps.expectedResult: Restorable backup exists.

steps.title: Implement the change
steps.instructionMd: Implement the change exactly as approved, with a second engineer verifying each action.
steps.expectedResult: Change implemented as approved.

steps.title: Verify service health
steps.instructionMd: Verify the change resolved the issue and dependent services are healthy.
steps.commandBlock:
systemctl --failed
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://<service-host>/health
steps.expectedResult: Issue resolved; services healthy.

steps.title: Complete the retrospective CAB review
steps.instructionMd: Present the change at the next CAB within 5 business days and record the outcome.
steps.expectedResult: Retrospective review recorded.

escalations.instructions: Emergency change step failed; decide whether to roll back.
Emergency change at 80% of its window.

rollback.title: Roll back the emergency change
rollback.instructionMd: Restore the pre-change configuration or snapshot and verify services.
rollback.commandBlock:
git -C <config_repo> checkout pre-ecab-<change_id> -- .
# FortiGate
# execute restore config tftp <backup_file> <tftp_server_ip>
rollback.verification: Services healthy on the pre-change configuration.
